response_text:

The resolver first checks its cache to see if it already has the IP address for the domain name. Finally, the resolver contacts the authoritative name server for example.com to obtain the IP address of the domain name. The authoritative name server responds with the IP address, and the resolver stores it in its cache. For example, when you enter "www.example.com" in a web browser, the DNS resolver first contacts a root DNS server to obtain the IP address of the TLD DNS server responsible for ".com" domains. The resolver then contacts the TLD DNS server to obtain the IP address of the authoritative DNS server for "example.com".
